name: Audity DJ
author: Audity
description: The talking DJ for the Audity app, on Navidrome, Jellyfin or Plex: its voice made on this server only while a DJ session is on, and what the DJ remembers for each account, shared by all your devices.

versions.changelog: Lines made faster again: the voice's language model no longer works out word guesses it never uses, about half its work a step, with the sound exactly the same.
Lines made about twice as fast in the voice's flow head, its weights in 8 bits, with the sound kept (the language model, which sets the words and their timing, stays in full precision).
Try a Line says it in the voice picked, those added for one account too, and shows where the time went on this server: loading the voice, speaking, and checking.
A cleaner page in AudioMuse-AI's own style: each voice's name, description and account can be edited, as Audity shows them, and its clip played from its row.
Lines at the voice's full quality (44.1 kHz) for the Audity builds that play it; earlier builds still get 24 kHz.

Jellyfin and Plex accounts sign in too; the voices are named Theo and Juno; lines said before are kept and sent at once; a line is sent the moment it's made; songs that sound alike for the server you signed in to; the crackle between pauses fixed; the page's downloads and voices kept to AudioMuse-AI's admins.
First release: the DJ's voice (Ming-3.0-tts 0.5B on the processor), two voices and your own, lines checked with speech-to-text, and the DJ's memory per Navidrome account.
